blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Traffic Enforcement Agency of Mandaue (TEAM) will implement road closures and parking regulations near cemeteries from October 31 to November 2 to manage traffic and accommodate the expected influx of visitors during All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. TEAM head Hyll Retuya said road closures will be enforced along portions of B. B. Cabahug Street, F. B. Cabahug Street, A. S. Fortuna Street near its intersection with B. B. Cabahug Street, and F. S. Rosal Street. He said the measures are implemented annually to provide more space for pedestrians and vendors near cemeteries, with vehicles […]...
